latest.title: How to Create Custom Images for Amazon SageMaker Studio and Unified Studio
latest.description: This post shows how to build a single Docker image with custom ML packages that works across both SageMaker Studio V2 and Unified Studio by using platform-specific AppImageConfigs to control the entrypoint. It walks through a PyTorch computer vision example end-to-end — from Dockerfile authoring and ECR push to SageMaker registration and domain attachment — with troubleshooting guidance for common pitfalls.

latest.title: Closed-Loop AI Delivery: Integrating Quick, Kiro, and Claude Code
latest.description: A best-practices guide for integrating Amazon Quick, Kiro, and Claude Code as a closed-loop delivery system. Covers the synergy model, team onboarding checklists, integration patterns (Research→Spec→Build, Context Injection, ADR Pipeline, Quality Gates), steering file templates, role-based workflow matrices, MCP extensibility, reusable Skills/commands, scheduled automation, and anti-patterns. Enables teams to eliminate context loss between tools and enforce conventions at scale.

latest.title: O que fazer depois de terminar um curso (e por que isso importa mais do que o curso em si)
latest.description: Terminar um curso não significa estar pronto — e é exatamente depois dele que o aprendizado de verdade começa. Neste artigo, você vai entender como transformar conteúdo em prática, evitar um dos erros mais comuns de quem está começando em tecnologia e como ambientes como o AWS Builder Center podem acelerar esse processo através de prática, comunidade e projetos reais.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: ASET – Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth
trending.description:
ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is a scientific claim verification engine built  for the AI era — where information can be generated instantly, but trust cannot, to address the growing problem of hallucinated citations and  AI-generated information.

Instead of probabilistic prediction, ASET retrieves, analyzes, and synthesizes evidence from 1.2M+ indexed research papers to produce literature-backed verification reports for claims extracted from text, documents, webpages, images, and videos.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: NeuroVoice
trending.description: Small moments, repeated daily, reveal what single snapshots never can - patterns that quietly signal neurological risk. NeuroVoice is a multimodal Parkinson’s screening platform that tracks pattern over time to detect subtle neurological changes early.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: Global Impact AI Navigator
trending.description: Global Impact AI Navigator (GIAN) is a multi-agent AI platform built on Amazon Bedrock that transforms a raw idea into a complete strategic package in under 60 seconds — SWOT diagnostic, live-grounded funding discovery, personalized roadmap, and a context-aware advisor. Designed for innovators in emerging markets, it democratizes access to the strategic guidance that usually requires expensive consultants or elite networks.

trending.title: Dynamic Looping Comes to AWS SAM
trending.description: AWS SAM CLI now supports CloudFormation Language Extensions, bringing Fn::ForEach, Fn::Length, Fn::ToJsonString, FindInMap with default values, and conditional deletion policies to your local development workflow. Define a resource once and generate as many as you need. Build, invoke, validate, package, deploy, and sync all work with language extensions out of the box. This post walks through each extension with working examples and shows how SAM CLI handles dynamic looping end-to-end.
